meta.framework: Level, trend, distribution. 100 indicators across 5 themes from primary sources.
meta.source_note: Values curated from WB PIP, WHO GHO/GHE, UN IGME, UNAIDS, IRENA, IEA, BloombergNEF, ITU, UNESCO UIS, FAO, NOAA, NASA GISTEMP, NSIDC, WWF/ZSL LPI, IUCN, UCDP, UNHCR, IDMC, V-Dem, WGI, TI CPI, SIPRI, UNODC, IMF WEO, OECD ODA, WHR.

indicators.name: Top supercomputer (Rmax)
indicators.definition: LINPACK performance of the top-ranked TOP500 machine.
indicators.caveat: Reported in flops; benchmark-specific, not equal to real-world AI throughput.

indicators.name: Frontier AI training compute
indicators.definition: Estimated training FLOP of notable frontier models.
indicators.caveat: Frontier opacity rising; many recent training runs not publicly disclosed.

indicators.name: PCT international patent filings
indicators.definition: Patent Cooperation Treaty applications filed globally.
indicators.caveat: Counts not quality- or diffusion-weighted.

indicators.name: Scientific journal articles
indicators.definition: Annual scientific and technical journal articles published.
indicators.caveat: Counts ignore citation impact and disciplinary mix.

indicators.name: Internet users
indicators.definition: Share of world population using the internet.
indicators.caveat: Usage is not speed, quality, or affordability.

indicators.name: Fixed broadband subscriptions
indicators.definition: Fixed broadband subscriptions per 100 inhabitants.
indicators.caveat: Does not capture speed or outage frequency.

indicators.name: 5G population coverage
indicators.definition: Share of world population with a 5G signal available.
indicators.caveat: Nominal signal is not effective service.

indicators.name: International bandwidth per user
indicators.definition: Available international internet bandwidth per user.
indicators.caveat: CDN architecture distorts cross-country comparisons.

indicators.name: Access to electricity
indicators.definition: Share of world population with electricity access.
indicators.caveat: Access is binary; reliability and affordability not captured.

indicators.name: Access to clean cooking
indicators.definition: Share of population with clean cooking fuels and technologies.
indicators.caveat: Affordability shocks reverse progress; modeled in many countries.

indicators.name: Renewable power additions
indicators.definition: New renewable power generation capacity added annually.
indicators.caveat: Capacity ≠ generation; curtailment omitted.

indicators.name: Renewable share of capacity
indicators.definition: Renewables as % of global installed electricity capacity.
indicators.caveat: Capacity share overstates actual output (lower load factors).

indicators.name: Solar PV LCOE
indicators.definition: Levelized cost of electricity from utility-scale solar.
indicators.caveat: Site quality and financing create wide spreads.

indicators.name: Lithium-ion battery pack price
indicators.definition: Volume-weighted-average price of lithium-ion battery packs.
indicators.caveat: Pack-level price; cell-level lower. Chemistry mix shifts fast.

indicators.name: EV share of new car sales
indicators.definition: Battery and plug-in electric vehicles as share of new car sales.
indicators.caveat: Sales share is policy-sensitive; stock evolves slower.

indicators.name: Grid-scale battery storage
indicators.definition: Cumulative grid-scale battery storage installed worldwide.
indicators.caveat: Stock figures revise annually; chemistry mix evolving.

indicators.name: Cost to sequence a human genome
indicators.definition: Cost to sequence a single human genome at production scale.
indicators.caveat: Production cost only; analysis and storage costs separate.

indicators.name: Transistor count per chip
indicators.definition: Transistor count of leading-edge processors.
indicators.caveat: Chip area and architecture differences make this a rough proxy.

indicators.name: LLM cost per million tokens
indicators.definition: Cost per million tokens at GPT-3.5-equivalent capability.
indicators.caveat: Capability comparison is approximate; benchmarks shift.

indicators.name: R&D expenditure
indicators.definition: Research and development expenditure as share of world GDP.
indicators.caveat: Accounting standards differ; reversals possible in slowdowns.

indicators.name: Life expectancy at birth
indicators.definition: Expected years at birth under current mortality.
indicators.caveat: Pandemic shock broke trend; some series are modeled.

indicators.name: Healthy life expectancy
indicators.definition: Expected healthy years at birth.
indicators.caveat: More modeled than raw mortality; pandemic disruption.

indicators.name: Under-5 mortality
indicators.definition: Deaths before age 5 per 1,000 live births.
indicators.caveat: Inter-agency estimates revise back-history.

indicators.name: Neonatal mortality
indicators.definition: Deaths in first 28 days of life per 1,000 live births.
indicators.caveat: Slower decline than under-5 mortality overall.

indicators.name: Maternal mortality ratio
indicators.definition: Maternal deaths per 100,000 live births.
indicators.caveat: Wide uncertainty in fragile settings.

indicators.name: TB incidence
indicators.definition: Tuberculosis incidence per 100,000 population.
indicators.caveat: Under-diagnosis and estimation remain material.

indicators.name: TB deaths
indicators.definition: Annual tuberculosis deaths worldwide.
indicators.caveat: Cohort reporting lags; 79M lives saved 2000-2023.

indicators.name: New HIV infections
indicators.definition: Annual new HIV infections worldwide.
indicators.caveat: Modelled estimates; key populations undercounted.

indicators.name: AIDS-related deaths
indicators.definition: Annual deaths from AIDS-related illness.
indicators.caveat: Down 70% from peak; off the SDG 2030 trajectory in some regions.

indicators.name: ART coverage (HIV)
indicators.definition: People living with HIV receiving antiretroviral therapy.
indicators.caveat: Denominator revisions can move the ratio.

indicators.name: Malaria deaths
indicators.definition: Annual malaria deaths worldwide.
indicators.caveat: Recent slight uptick; surveillance quality varies.

indicators.name: DTP3 vaccine coverage
indicators.definition: Third-dose DTP coverage among one-year-olds.
indicators.caveat: Pandemic-era dropouts only partially recovered.

indicators.name: Measles vaccine coverage
indicators.definition: First-dose measles immunization coverage.
indicators.caveat: Outbreaks can spike despite high national averages.

indicators.name: Wild polio cases
indicators.definition: Wild poliovirus cases worldwide.
indicators.caveat: Two endemic countries (Afghanistan, Pakistan).

indicators.name: Guinea worm cases
indicators.definition: Annual confirmed guinea worm disease cases.
indicators.caveat: Endgame; 10 cases reported in 2025 YTD.

indicators.name: Premature NCD mortality
indicators.definition: Probability of dying between ages 30 and 70 from the 4 main NCDs.
indicators.caveat: Pandemic plateau; tobacco and metabolic risk driving variation.

indicators.name: Road traffic mortality
indicators.definition: Road injury deaths per 100,000 population.
indicators.caveat: Under-reporting still common; LMICs bear most burden.

indicators.name: Safely managed drinking water
indicators.definition: Population using safely managed drinking water services.
indicators.caveat: Water quality testing coverage still uneven.

indicators.name: Safely managed sanitation
indicators.definition: Population using safely managed sanitation services.
indicators.caveat: Slow progress and definitional complexity in non-sewered systems.

indicators.name: Open defecation
indicators.definition: Population practicing open defecation.
indicators.caveat: Concentrated in a small number of countries.

indicators.name: Extreme poverty ($3/day, 2021 PPP)
indicators.definition: Population below $3/day in 2021 PPP.
indicators.caveat: Post-pandemic progress stalled; line revised June 2025.

indicators.name: People under $6.85/day
indicators.definition: People living on less than $6.85/day (2017 PPP).
indicators.caveat: Count barely moved despite population growth; the 'middle-income line' debate.

indicators.name: GDP per capita PPP
indicators.definition: Real world GDP per capita at purchasing-power parity.
indicators.caveat: PPP benchmark revisions are major.

indicators.name: Gini index (global, between-country)
indicators.definition: Income inequality, between-country dimension (smaller is more equal).
indicators.caveat: Between-country down; within-country up in many places.

indicators.name: Income share, bottom 50%
indicators.definition: Pre-tax income share held by the bottom 50% globally.
indicators.caveat: Modeled; survey gaps in low-income panels.

indicators.name: Top 1% wealth share
indicators.definition: Share of global wealth held by the top 1%.
indicators.caveat: Underestimates due to offshore wealth; methodology contested.

indicators.name: Unemployment rate
indicators.definition: Modeled global unemployment as % of labor force.
indicators.caveat: Modeled estimates smooth country-level volatility.

indicators.name: Youth NEET rate
indicators.definition: Youth (15-24) not in employment, education, or training.
indicators.caveat: Definitions vary across statistical systems.

indicators.name: FAO Food Price Index
indicators.definition: FAO Food Price Index (nominal, 2014-16=100).
indicators.caveat: Global index ≠ household affordability.

indicators.name: Undernourishment prevalence
indicators.definition: Share of population undernourished.
indicators.caveat: Multi-year smoothing; pandemic spike now slowly receding.

indicators.name: Moderate or severe food insecurity
indicators.definition: FIES-based food insecurity prevalence.
indicators.caveat: Survey-based; wording effects matter.

indicators.name: Primary completion rate
indicators.definition: Completion of primary education, both sexes.
indicators.caveat: Estimated from multiple underlying sources.

indicators.name: Lower secondary completion
indicators.definition: Completion of lower secondary education.
indicators.caveat: Larger gaps in low-income settings.

indicators.name: Upper secondary completion
indicators.definition: Completion of upper secondary education.
indicators.caveat: Slower progress, larger regional gaps.

indicators.name: Learning proficiency
indicators.definition: Children reaching minimum proficiency in reading by end of primary.
indicators.caveat: Pandemic learning loss; harmonization across assessment families imperfect.

indicators.name: Adult literacy rate
indicators.definition: Literate adult population age 15 and older.
indicators.caveat: Long-arc indicator; some countries use self-report or older census inputs.

indicators.name: Female adult literacy
indicators.definition: Female literate adult population age 15 and older.
indicators.caveat: Gender gap closing but persistent in low-income settings.

indicators.name: Mean years of schooling (25+)
indicators.definition: Mean years of schooling among adults 25+.
indicators.caveat: Five-year-step estimates; revisions when censuses arrive.

indicators.name: Out-of-school children (primary age)
indicators.definition: Children of primary age not in school.
indicators.caveat: Concentrated in conflict-affected and low-income countries.

indicators.name: Child labour (ages 5-17)
indicators.definition: Children in child labour, ages 5-17.
indicators.caveat: 2020 reversal: first rise in two decades, pandemic effect.

indicators.name: Annual fossil CO₂ emissions
indicators.definition: Annual fossil-fuel CO₂ emissions.
indicators.caveat: Territorial basis omits trade-adjustment.

indicators.name: CO₂ emissions per capita
indicators.definition: Territorial CO₂ emissions per person.
indicators.caveat: Service-import effects hide rich-country emissions.

indicators.name: Atmospheric CO₂
indicators.definition: Atmospheric CO₂ concentration (Mauna Loa annual).
indicators.caveat: Single global series; preindustrial baseline ~280 ppm.

indicators.name: Global temperature anomaly
indicators.definition: Global mean surface temperature anomaly vs 1951-1980 baseline.
indicators.caveat: 2024 hottest year; +1.47°C vs 1850-1900 baseline.

indicators.name: Sea level rise
indicators.definition: Global mean sea level rise since 1993 (satellite altimetry).
indicators.caveat: Rate doubled from 2.1 mm/yr (1993) to 4.5 mm/yr (2024).

indicators.name: Arctic sea ice (September min)
indicators.definition: Arctic sea ice extent at September minimum.
indicators.caveat: Approximately -13% per decade trend.

indicators.name: Atmospheric methane
indicators.definition: Atmospheric methane concentration (NOAA global mean).
indicators.caveat: Recent acceleration not fully attributed.

indicators.name: Carbon intensity of GDP
indicators.definition: CO₂ emissions per unit of GDP (PPP).
indicators.caveat: Derived metric; combines emissions and GDP revisions.

indicators.name: Energy intensity of GDP
indicators.definition: Total primary energy supply per unit of GDP (PPP).
indicators.caveat: Structural economic change affects interpretation.

indicators.name: Renewable share of final energy
indicators.definition: Renewables in total final energy consumption.
indicators.caveat: Traditional biomass can make scores look deceptively 'green'.

indicators.name: Fossil share of electricity
indicators.definition: Fossil sources as share of electricity generation.
indicators.caveat: Electricity is only one part of total energy.

indicators.name: Forest area share
indicators.definition: Forest area as % of land area.
indicators.caveat: Area says nothing about biodiversity quality.

indicators.name: Net forest loss
indicators.definition: Net annual forest area loss.
indicators.caveat: Net of plantations; primary-forest loss separate and higher.

indicators.name: Protected terrestrial area
indicators.definition: Protected and conserved share of terrestrial area.
indicators.caveat: Legal designation is not effective protection.

indicators.name: Protected marine area
indicators.definition: Protected and conserved share of marine areas.
indicators.caveat: Paper protection is a real risk; high-seas governance weak.

indicators.name: Red List Index
indicators.definition: IUCN Red List Index of species survival.
indicators.caveat: Assessment coverage differs by taxon and region.

indicators.name: Living Planet Index
indicators.definition: Average change in monitored vertebrate populations since 1970.
indicators.caveat: Geometric mean of trends, NOT '73% of animals lost'. Methodology contested.

indicators.name: Mean PM2.5 exposure
indicators.definition: Population-weighted mean annual PM2.5 exposure.
indicators.caveat: Modeled and satellite-blended in many places.

indicators.name: Antarctic ozone hole area
indicators.definition: Maximum annual area of the Antarctic ozone hole.
indicators.caveat: Full recovery projected 2066; year-to-year volatility large.

indicators.name: Oil spills from tankers
indicators.definition: Oil spilled from tanker accidents annually.
indicators.caveat: Tanker-spill specific; pipeline and platform incidents tracked separately.

indicators.name: Battle-related deaths
indicators.definition: Battle-related deaths in state-based armed conflicts.
indicators.caveat: Preliminary figures revise materially over time.

indicators.name: Active state-based conflicts
indicators.definition: Number of active state-based armed conflicts.
indicators.caveat: Threshold-based; record post-1946 count.

indicators.name: World military expenditure
indicators.definition: Total world military spending in constant 2023 USD.
indicators.caveat: Secrecy and exchange-rate issues; constant USD.

indicators.name: Nuclear warheads (world stockpile)
indicators.definition: Total nuclear warheads in global stockpile.
indicators.caveat: Includes retired warheads pending dismantlement.

indicators.name: Refugees (UNHCR mandate)
indicators.definition: Refugees and asylum-seekers under UNHCR mandate.
indicators.caveat: Mandate and return-status definitions evolve.

indicators.name: Internally displaced persons
indicators.definition: IDPs due to conflict, violence, and disasters.
indicators.caveat: Stock can fall due to forced returns or reclassification.

indicators.name: Forcibly displaced (total)
indicators.definition: Total forcibly displaced (refugees + IDPs + asylum + others).
indicators.caveat: 1 in 67 humans displaced; ~2x a decade ago.

indicators.name: V-Dem Liberal Democracy Index
indicators.definition: Population-weighted liberal democracy score.
indicators.caveat: Back to 1985 levels; 72% of world lives in autocracies.

indicators.name: Democracies vs autocracies
indicators.definition: Number of democracies (electoral or liberal) worldwide.
indicators.caveat: First time in 20+ years autocracies (91) outnumber democracies (88).

indicators.name: Freedom in the World decline
indicators.definition: Countries with declines minus countries with improvements (Freedom House).
indicators.caveat: 20 consecutive years of net decline.

indicators.name: Rule of law
indicators.definition: Worldwide Governance Indicator: Rule of Law.
indicators.caveat: Perception-heavy and low-frequency movement.

indicators.name: Global homicide rate
indicators.definition: Global intentional homicide rate.
indicators.caveat: Criminal-justice reporting quality varies.

indicators.name: Journalists killed
indicators.definition: Journalists killed on the job (motive confirmed).
indicators.caveat: Deadliest year in CPJ's 30+ year history; ~70% Israel/Gaza/Lebanon.

indicators.name: General government gross debt
indicators.definition: Global general government gross debt as share of GDP.
indicators.caveat: Projected to reach 100% by 2029.

indicators.name: Net official development assistance
indicators.definition: DAC members' net ODA, constant 2022 USD.
indicators.caveat: Decline from 2023 peak; excludes some South-South finance.

indicators.name: Life evaluation (Cantril ladder)
indicators.definition: Global average Cantril ladder life evaluation.
indicators.caveat: Survey response styles differ by culture and age.

indicators.name: Documented AI incidents
indicators.definition: Recorded AI harms or near-harms.
indicators.caveat: Discovery/reporting rises with media attention.

indicators.name: Countries with female suffrage
indicators.definition: Countries where women have voting rights.
indicators.caveat: De jure suffrage; de facto participation differs.

indicators.name: Female heads of government (serving)
indicators.definition: Women serving as heads of government simultaneously.
indicators.caveat: Snapshot of currently-serving; 63 countries have had a female HoG since 1960.

indicators.name: Same-sex marriage countries
indicators.definition: Countries where same-sex marriage is legal.
indicators.caveat: Cumulative; reversals are rare but possible.
